title: Schedule of Service-Recovery Ceilings by Late-Fee Record, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Service-recovery ceiling on billing-error correction credits — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.**

| Late fees posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (any kind, erroneous or not) | Service-recovery ceiling |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | $25.00 ¹ |
| 3 or 4 | $15.00 ¹ |
| 5 or more | not raised under this schedule ² |

¹ The ceiling is the most the service-recovery amount may be: the amount is compared with the ceiling and the lower of the two is kept.

² For five or more late fees in the window this schedule makes no adjustment.

**Notes.**
- Every late fee entry posted on the agreement counts, whether or not it was charged in error and whether or not it has been corrected, including the fee being corrected when it was posted inside the window.
- A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month; a late fee is placed in the window by its posting date.
- Boundaries: 2 late fees gives $25.00, 3 gives $15.00; 4 gives $15.00, 5 is outside this schedule.

Hypothetical reading: a service-recovery amount of $19.40 on an agreement with 3 late fees in the window is held to $15.00; with 2 late fees it stays $19.40.
